statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-48702 (GHSA-47q9-m4ww-924m, GO-2026-5778): Rekor's Alpine package entry type (Package.Unmarshal in pkg/types/alpine/apk.go) decompressed the signature and control gzip members of a submitted APK without a size bound, so a crafted entry sent to a Rekor server could exhaust its memory. Affected is github.com/sigstore/rekor 0.3.0 before 1.5.2 (https://github.com/sigstore/rekor/security/advisories/GHSA-47q9-m4ww-924m, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5778, fix commit https://github.com/sigstore/rekor/commit/759b98e2a7c39ea9779b6a51299c5f0f987f8802). Checked every scout-cli-dev package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository by 2026-11-27: 25 builds, 1.20.4-r1 to 1.30.0-r1, each for x86_64 and aarch64. Each holds /usr/bin/docker-scout, the -dev build of the Docker Scout CLI, a Go program built with CGO_ENABLED=0; we read its Go build information from every published package. github.com/sigstore/rekor is v1.5.0 in 1.20.4-r1 to 1.23.1-r0, v1.5.2 in 1.23.1-r1 to 1.23.1-r9, v1.5.4 in 1.23.1-r10 to 1.30.0-r1; both architectures agree for every build. Only 1.20.4-r1 to 1.23.1-r0 carry an affected release (github.com/sigstore/rekor v1.5.0); 1.23.1-r1 and later carry v1.5.2 or later. We listed the symbols of the binaries for 1.20.4-r1 to 1.23.1-r2, which covers all of those builds, on both architectures with go tool nm and searched each whole binary for the function names (the Go function name table also lists inlined functions): none contains github.com/sigstore/rekor/pkg/types/alpine, while the same search finds other Rekor entry types (github.com/sigstore/rekor/pkg/types/hashedrekord) and runtime.main in every one. The Docker Scout CLI uses Rekor client and entry types for verification but not the Alpine package type, so the vulnerable code is not present in any published build.

CVE-2026-48702 (GHSA-47q9-m4ww-924m, GO-2026-5778): the Rekor server decompresses the signature and control members of an Alpine APK entry without bounding their size, in Package.Unmarshal in pkg/types/alpine, so an unauthenticated request with a gzip bomb can exhaust its memory. It affects github.com/sigstore/rekor 0.3.0 before 1.5.2. Sources: https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5778, https://github.com/sigstore/rekor/security/advisories/GHSA-47q9-m4ww-924m and the fix https://github.com/sigstore/rekor/commit/759b98e2a7c39ea9779b6a51299c5f0f987f8802 (pkg/types/alpine/apk.go). We checked every scout-sbom-indexer-dev package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository as of 28 November 2026: 25 builds, 1.20.4-r1 to the current 1.30.0-r0, on x86_64 and aarch64 (50 packages). Each package holds one file, /sbom-indexer, a statically linked Go program for Linux built with CGO_ENABLED=0 (no program interpreter and no shared-library dependencies). We read the program in full from every package, except 1.26.0-r3, whose program has the same SHA-1 checksum, recorded in its package header, as the 1.26.0-r2 program we read. The -dev program is built without the -w linker flag and without -trimpath, but it carries the same Go release and module versions as the scout-sbom-indexer program of the same build. Its Go build information lists github.com/sigstore/rekor, with no replace directive for that module and the same on both architectures: v1.5.0 in 1.20.4-r1 to 1.23.1-r0, v1.5.2 in 1.23.1-r1 to 1.23.1-r10 and v1.5.4 in 1.26.0-r1 to 1.30.0-r0. Reading the program's Go function table in every build (runtime.main found in every build as a control) shows the Rekor client and the hashedrekord, rekord, dsse and intoto entry types linked, and no function from github.com/sigstore/rekor/pkg/types/alpine. A byte search of every build, which also finds the names of functions the compiler inlined, finds no sigstore/rekor/pkg/types/alpine, while the same search finds sigstore/rekor/pkg/types/hashedrekord in every build as a positive control. So the Alpine entry type and its Package.Unmarshal are not present in any build, whichever Rekor version it carries; the program is a Rekor client, and the vulnerable decompression runs in the Rekor server. Debian 13 marks its rekor package no-dsa for this CVE; this decision rests on the code in these builds, not on that status.

Sources: https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5778, https://github.com/sigstore/rekor/security/advisories/GHSA-47q9-m4ww-924m and the fix https://github.com/sigstore/rekor/commit/759b98e2a7c39ea9779b6a51299c5f0f987f8802 (pkg/types/alpine/apk.go). Each package holds one file, /sbom-indexer, a statically linked Go program for Linux built with CGO_ENABLED=0 (no program interpreter and no shared-library dependencies). We read the program in full from every package, except 1.26.0-r3, whose program has the same SHA-1 checksum, recorded in its package header, as the 1.26.0-r2 program we read. statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-48702 (GHSA-47q9-m4ww-924m, GO-2026-5778): Rekor's Alpine package entry type (Package.Unmarshal in pkg/types/alpine/apk.go) decompressed the signature and control gzip members of a submitted APK without a size bound, so a crafted entry sent to a Rekor server could exhaust its memory. Affected is github.com/sigstore/rekor 0.3.0 before 1.5.2 (https://github.com/sigstore/rekor/security/advisories/GHSA-47q9-m4ww-924m, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5778, fix commit https://github.com/sigstore/rekor/commit/759b98e2a7c39ea9779b6a51299c5f0f987f8802). Checked every scout-cli-dev package published for Debian 13 in the DHI Debian repository by 2026-11-27: 25 builds, 1.20.4-1 to 1.30.0-1, each for amd64 and arm64. Each installs one file, /usr/bin/docker-scout, the -dev build of the Docker Scout CLI; in every build that binary carries the same Go build ID (which includes a hash of the linked program) as the Alpine 3.23 scout-cli-dev build of the same version and architecture, a Go program built with CGO_ENABLED=0 whose Go build information we read. github.com/sigstore/rekor is v1.5.0 in 1.20.4-1 to 1.23.1-0, v1.5.2 in 1.23.1-1 to 1.23.1-9, v1.5.4 in 1.23.1-10 to 1.30.0-1; both architectures agree for every build. Only 1.20.4-1 to 1.23.1-0 carry an affected release (github.com/sigstore/rekor v1.5.0); 1.23.1-1 and later carry v1.5.2 or later. We listed the symbols of the Alpine 3.23 scout-cli-dev binaries that are byte-identical to the Debian ones (the same MD5 as the Debian package lists) for 1.20.4-1 to 1.23.1-2, which covers all of those builds, on both architectures with go tool nm and searched each whole binary for the function names (the Go function name table also lists inlined functions): none contains github.com/sigstore/rekor/pkg/types/alpine, while the same search finds other Rekor entry types (github.com/sigstore/rekor/pkg/types/hashedrekord) and runtime.main in every one. The Docker Scout CLI uses Rekor client and entry types for verification but not the Alpine package type, so the vulnerable code is not present in any published build.

CVE-2026-48702 (GHSA-47q9-m4ww-924m, GO-2026-5778): the Rekor server decompresses the signature and control members of an Alpine APK entry without bounding their size, in Package.Unmarshal in pkg/types/alpine, so an unauthenticated request with a gzip bomb can exhaust its memory. It affects github.com/sigstore/rekor 0.3.0 before 1.5.2. Sources: https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5778, https://github.com/sigstore/rekor/security/advisories/GHSA-47q9-m4ww-924m and the fix https://github.com/sigstore/rekor/commit/759b98e2a7c39ea9779b6a51299c5f0f987f8802 (pkg/types/alpine/apk.go). We checked every scout-sbom-indexer package published for Debian 13 in the DHI Debian repository as of 28 November 2026: 25 builds, 1.20.4-1 to the current 1.30.0-0, on amd64 and arm64 (50 packages). Each package installs one file, /sbom-indexer, as listed in the md5sums manifest of its control archive, and the MD5 checksum recorded there equals that of the program we read in full from the Alpine 3.23 package of the same version, revision number and architecture (for example 1.20.4-5 matches 1.20.4-r5; 1.26.0-3 matches the 1.26.0-r2 program, which 1.26.0-r3 also carries), so these packages carry the same statically linked Go programs, built with CGO_ENABLED=0 (no program interpreter and no shared-library dependencies). Its Go build information lists github.com/sigstore/rekor, with no replace directive for that module and the same on both architectures: v1.5.0 in 1.20.4-1 to 1.23.1-0, v1.5.2 in 1.23.1-1 to 1.23.1-10 and v1.5.4 in 1.26.0-1 to 1.30.0-0. Reading the program's Go function table in every build (runtime.main found in every build as a control) shows the Rekor client and the hashedrekord, rekord, dsse and intoto entry types linked, and no function from github.com/sigstore/rekor/pkg/types/alpine. A byte search of every build, which also finds the names of functions the compiler inlined, finds no sigstore/rekor/pkg/types/alpine, while the same search finds sigstore/rekor/pkg/types/hashedrekord in every build as a positive control. So the Alpine entry type and its Package.Unmarshal are not present in any build, whichever Rekor version it carries; the program is a Rekor client, and the vulnerable decompression runs in the Rekor server. Debian 13 marks its rekor package no-dsa for this CVE; this decision rests on the code in these builds, not on that status.
